v2ray.linkPlaceholder: vless://… vmess://… trojan://… ss://… hy2://… tuic://…
v2ray.linkHint: Paste the link your provider gave you. VLESS (incl. REALITY), VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2 and TUIC are supported.
v2ray.unsupported: Unsupported link. It must start with vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss://, hysteria2://, hy2:// or tuic://.
v2ray.containerNote: The client runs as a small container on the router. The first setup downloads the sing-box image and can take a few minutes. The container package must be enabled on the router.
v2ray.subscriptionHint: The panel downloads the server list, keeps up to 20 servers and switches to the fastest one automatically.
v2ray.subscriptionInvalid: Enter an http:// or https:// URL.
v2ray.subscriptionNote: The server list is refreshed every 12 hours. The subscription is downloaded over the router's foreign link, so your subscription provider sees that link's IP address. Traffic and DNS only ever leave through the tunnel; if every server is down, traffic stops instead of leaking.
